prompt: Given an array where every element appears twice except for one unique element, how can the unique element be found in O(n) time and O(1) space?
options: Compute the cumulative XOR sum of all elements in the array
Insert all elements into a balanced BST
Compute the sum of array elements minus n
explanation: Because XOR is commutative and associative, and x ^ x = 0, all paired numbers cancel each other out to 0, leaving 0 ^ unique = unique.
